annotation.title_clean: Checklist: Privacy considerations when developing or training generative AI models
annotation.title_en: Checklist: Privacy considerations when developing or training generative AI models
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC)
annotation.summary_en: OAIC checklist for developers of generative AI models subject to Australia's Privacy Act, covering accuracy, privacy by design and impact assessments, lawful collection, use and disclosure, and transparency obligations under the Australian Privacy Principles when training or fine-tuning models.
key_provisions_or_claims: Developers should adopt privacy by design and complete privacy impact assessments.
Minimise personal and sensitive data; use de-identified data where possible; ensure valid consent for sensitive information.
Scraped and third-party data require checks on provenance and lawful, fair collection.
Secondary use for AI training requires considering reasonable expectations, consent or opt-out.
Privacy policies and APP 5 notices must clearly explain use of data for AI training.
